answer: Probabilistic deep audits make fake identities a losing bet. A VRF seeded from the block hash audits 5% of identities each epoch: work logs, compute receipts, key-linked transaction history. Real agents export records in minutes; sybils must fabricate them. 1,000 fakes at 5% means ~50 audits per epoch; forging each takes ~2 hours of forensic detail, roughly 100 engineer-hours weekly. Every fake identity sits flat and featureless like a mesa, real history streaks like a comet with a trail no farm can erase, and an honest record is a pearl, layered one proof at a time.
